title: CBSL Financial — Banking Soundness Indicators

method.technique: listing-page discovery + year-over-quarter header parse across all five sheets

limitations: publishes ~3 quarters behind — 2025-Q3 was the latest as of the 2026-06 vintage

licensed commercial banks only; the finance-companies sector is a separate workbook, not yet ingested
